status: Prepared learning templates only — not imported to or executed in Azure DevOps
process: Illustrative Agile backlog; adapt field names to the organization process

stories.title: Calculate consolidated component requirements
stories.userStory: As a planner, I want requirements aggregated across all products so shared components are not counted independently against the same stock.
acceptanceCriteria: At base demand C01 required quantity is 40×2 +30×3 =170.
Each component has one consolidated row before comparison with available stock.
Unknown or duplicate product-component references are rejected.
proposedUAT: UAT-01 planner checks base input and C01 total against manual calculation

stories.title: Identify shortage exposure
stories.userStory: As a planner, I want shortages based on on-hand stock less reservations so I can identify which components need investigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Available C01 quantity is100−10 =90; shortage max(170−90,0)=80.
Base scenario has2 shortage components and shortage value1460 USD.
Zero shortage has0 exposure; no negative shortages are displayed.
proposedUAT: UAT-02 planner checks C01 and C05 and inspects affected assemblies

stories.title: Explain KPIs and scope before decisions
stories.userStory: As a decision-maker, I want KPI definitions and limitations visible so I can interpret the planning snapshot correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: The page identifies synthetic data and the scenario demand scale.
Shortage value is labeled planning exposure, not savings or approved spend.
Affected products identifies exposure under the combined plan, not a feasible allocation schedule.
technicalTests: TEST-07 API returns JSON and rejects unsupported methods
proposedUAT: UAT-03 stakeholder reviews labels and requests clarification where needed

workflow: Intake: define planner problem and decision
Refinement: agree inputs, units, rules, acceptance criteria and dependencies
Prioritization: assess business impact, urgency, effort, risk and readiness with Product Owner
Testing: run technical checks and record evidence
Proposed UAT: ask representative business users to execute approved scenarios
Release decision: authorized owner reviews results and open risks
Stabilization: verify refresh/data issues, document corrections and update guidance
productionLimits: No actual Power BI .pbix or service deployment
No Azure DevOps organization or completed board usage
Single-level static BOM snapshot; no lead-time netting, substitutions, scrap factors, effectivity or production scheduling
